UNRESOLVED CONNECTIVITY. The code appears in SI Table S9 (peptoid 231) and nowhere in Figure 1B's drawn pool. The printed calculated exact mass pins the COMPOSITION at C4H10N, but C4H10N is satisfied by 2-(dimethylamino)ethyl, 3-(methylamino)propyl, 2-(methylamino)propyl and others, and mass cannot see connectivity. Figure 1B's 'Mae' is drawn as methylaminopropyl and has the SAME formula, which is precisely why the mass does not decide. NOT ENUMERATED; peptoid 231 is excluded from 03_enumerated.csv.
n-dodecyl. Figure 1B prints the formula C12H23, which is one hydrogen short of dodecyl (C12H25); SI Figure S7's legend prints 'Dod (C12)' and draws 12 vertices. See 08_contradictions.csv.

2-(ethylamino)ethanol (SI Materials, TCI). SECONDARY amine, same treatment as Dea. NOT DRAWN in Figure 1B's pool -- the code appears only in SI Table S9. The structure is the Materials-list reagent, and the calculated exact mass confirms the composition.
